business_problem: break down enterprise data silos so business units could share trusted information securely instead of moving data among separate lakes, databases, and spreadsheets.
solution_summary: Pfizer uses Snowflake, Snowpark, and Secure Data Sharing on Snowflake to break down enterprise data silos so business units could share trusted information securely instead of moving data among separate lakes, databases, and spreadsheets. Data from Oracle, Amazon S3, Teradata, spreadsheets, and multiple business domains now land in one Snowflake foundation instead of remaining scattered across separate lakes and warehouses. Pfizer uses the platform to standardize concurrency-heavy analytics and enterprise data sharing, with Snowpark and governed sharing patterns keeping more workloads close to the data. Commercial, manufacturing, finance, and other teams can access the same compliant and trusted data location, which improves collaboration and speeds analytics without shuttling files between departments. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, improves concurrency, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across teams and...

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowpark
solution_components.role: Runs transformations, analytics, and application logic directly where Snowflake data already lives.

solution_components.name: Secure Data Sharing
solution_components.role: Shares governed data with partners or internal consumers without moving copies.

data_flow: Oracle, S3, Teradata, spreadsheet, and line-of-business data flow into Snowflake, Snowpark, and Secure Data Sharing; curated data and model outputs are then served to commercial, manufacturing, finance, and enterprise analysts.
business_outcome: Pfizer achieved up to 4x faster analytics, reduced total cost of ownership by 57%, cut overall database costs by 28%, and made One Pfizer data sharing and governance practical at enterprise scale.
metrics: 57% reduction in TCO and 28% reduction in overall database costs vs. previous solution
architecture_clues: Replaced fragmented data sources across Oracle, Amazon S3, Teradata, and desktop spreadsheets.
Uses Snowflake as a single compliant and secure sharing location across domains.
Enterprise governance spans commercial, manufacturing, finance, and other business units.
